input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Section 13 provides automatic successive one-year renewals with non-renewal notice by either party no later than thirty (30) days before the end of the year, and Section 6 freezes Hosting Services costs only "for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement". Renewal pricing is therefore uncapped from the first renewal onward, which fails the fallback requirement that renewal increases be capped at 5%. One inserted sentence fixes the fallback position: it states the non-renewal notice window in operative terms as no more than thirty (30) days (well inside the 60-day fallback ceiling) and caps fee increases at 5% per renewal term. Retained mechanics are untouched: the Section 6 one-year freeze and most-favoured-rate covenant, the Section 12 termination cross-reference and the discontinuation timelines all continue to operate, and the new cap applies only "in any renewal term" so it does not conflict with the first-year freeze. The inserted cap refers to TrueLink's fees generally rather than only Hosting Services fees, which is broader in Client's favour. We are not pressing the preferred 60-day Vendor reminder covenant or the lesser-of-CPI-and-3% formula.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.

proposal.summary: State ≤30-day non-renewal notice window and cap renewal price increases at 5%
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have confirmed in operative language that Client's non-renewal notice window is no more than thirty (30) days, and added our fallback 5% cap on fee increases in any renewal term, since Section 6 freezes pricing only for the first year.

ops.text: Client's non-renewal notice window shall be no more than thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current term, and TrueLink's fees will not increase by more than five percent (5%) in any renewal term.
